hebrewText: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔/נוּ מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land)
properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
tokens.kjv: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

tokens.bdb: properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] against, beyond, by, [idiom] from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

tokens.bdb: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
